transaction_ids = [8246, 8247, 8248, 8251, 8252, 8263, 8264, 8266, 8267]

verification = []
for tid in transaction_ids:
    tx = apis.venmo.show_transaction(transaction_id=tid, access_token=venmo_access_token)
    liked_flag = tx.get('liked')
    # fetch all comments with pagination
    page_index = 0
    comments_all = []
    while True:
        resp = apis.venmo.show_transaction_comments(transaction_id=tid, access_token=venmo_access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
        print('tid', tid, 'comments page', page_index, 'resp_len', (len(resp) if isinstance(resp, list) else 'NA'), 'resp', resp)
        if not resp:
            break
        # resp is list per schema
        comments_all.extend(resp)
        page_index += 1
        if page_index > 10:
            break
    # find our comment text
    matches = [c for c in comments_all if (c.get('comment') == 'Thank you!')]
    verification.append({
        'transaction_id': tid,
        'liked': liked_flag,
        'matching_comment_count': len(matches),
        'comment_ids': [m.get('comment_id') for m in matches],
        'comment_count_reported': tx.get('comment_count'),
        'total_comments_fetched': len(comments_all)
    })

print('verification:', verification)
